designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service bought its first parcel of Missouri River floodplain for the Big Muddy National Fish and Wildlife Refuge.
designationHistory.note: One FWS source; it says the refuge was established in 1994 and dates the first purchase September 9, 1994. Authority not stated.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Big Muddy NFWR 'About Us' page
